claims.text: The deviation is established on this trip's own trace. EV-GPS-02825 records trace_distance_km of 18.2 km against the platform's optimal_distance_km of 14.0 km, an excess of 4.2 km and 30.0% of optimal. Under POL-RD-01 both gates pass — the excess exceeds 20% of optimal and exceeds 0.8 km in absolute terms — so the route deviation is ESTABLISHED and the rider is not left arguing about lane changes or a forced U-turn. The threshold test is run on the trace figure, which EV-GPS-02825 supplies and which governs over the rounded trip_record copy.

Disclosure of impairment on the trace I rely on: EV-GPS-02825 carries weight_multiplier 0.85 with issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW (a 40.0 s sampling gap from 14:00:32 to 14:01:12, 0.4 km apart). That impairment is schema-level only. Measured against POL-RD-07, the gap is under the 90 second limb (a), the jump is under the 500 m limb (b), and the sampling interval is 10 s, under the 30 s limb (c). The trace is therefore NOT impaired for policy purposes, its excess figure stands as measured, and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation is engaged. It is down-weighted in confidence under POL-GEN-02 alone.

The rider has carried her initial burden under POL-RD-08. The trip identifier TRP-02825 matches across EV-TRIP-02825, EV-GPS-02825 and EV-FARE-02825, and the timetable is consistent — the trace's first fix at 13:51:32 is the trip_record's started_at, and the fare's charged_at 14:22:17 follows the recorded trip_completed event. The excess of 4.2 km against the 0.8 km gate is shown on this same trace. The burden now shifts to the driver.

The rider's profile does not add any corroboration requirement to this claim. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the POL-RD-08 condition (4 or more claims with 1 or fewer substantiated) is nowhere near met and no source beyond the gps_trace is required to prove the excess. These are the only two rider-profile fields POL-GEN-01 permits to be used on this test, and both support the rider's position on this record.

The driver's stated excuse — 'Navigation rerouted me' — is tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else, and there is no advisory to test it against: EV-ADVIS-02825-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload. The driver names no advisory evidence ID. Under POL-RD-13 the missing advisory leaves POL-RD-03 unavailable, the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08, and the deviation stands at the measured 4.2 km with POL-RD-02 run against the booked optimal route of 14.0 km. The absence of an artifact no party has cited is not the contradiction POL-RD-10(5) escalates on.

No rider-side detour or relocation clause can rescue the driver either. The chat log EV-CHAT-02825 holds 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction to trigger POL-RD-04 and no waypoint_hint to corroborate; the waypoint test cannot even be run because no message exists. The trip_record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null, so POL-RD-05 never opens and the booked 14.0 km optimal stands unadjusted.

The refund is arithmetic, not discretionary. Under POL-RD-02 on a METERED fare: recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 14.0 km + 0.28 x 19.0 min) x 1.0 surge, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP/tolls + 0 waiting time fee - 0 promo = SGD 20.42. charged_total is SGD 26.73. Refund = 26.73 - 20.42 = SGD 6.31, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05, giving SGD 6.35 payable to the rider. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is 23.6% of charged_total, well under the 90% full-refund share, so the correct outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 6.35 — which is precisely what the fare breakdown itself publishes.

The fare model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and the distance-and-time refund route is not closed. The rider is not already whole on distance: she was charged for 18.2 km at 0.75/km and 30.3 minutes at 0.28/min on the EV-FARE-02825 ledger, and every one of those excess kilometres flowed through to her bill.

No pass-through line is added on top of the refund. The EV-FARE-02825 ledger carries 0 ERP gantry lines, 0 tolls and no airport surcharge (the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport), so the standalone corrections under POL-RD-09 do not arise and the off-route ERP comprehended in the POL-RD-02 figure is nil. The rider's recovery is the SGD 6.35 and nothing is double-counted.

The vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply and the 14.0 km optimal on the trip_record is the correct comparator. The 18.2 km driven is not co-rider collection distance on a pooled itinerary; it is excess on a solo trip, and it counts against the driver in full.

The present payment state is that the rider has paid and been refunded nothing: EV-FARE-02825 records payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 against a total_charged of SGD 26.73. A ruling of PARTIAL_REFUND at SGD 6.35 is what takes the disputed excess off the rider, and it leaves her not carrying the charge for the 4.2 km she did not travel.

claims.text: Even taken at the rider's highest, the excess is 4.2 km over the 14.0 km booked optimal — 30.0% — which clears POL-RD-01's establishment gate (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km) but is nowhere near the MATERIAL gate (greater than 50% or greater than 8.0 km). The deviation is therefore non-material, no adjustment under POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05 or POL-RD-12 applies on this record, and POL-RD-06's uplift machinery is not engaged. The measured excess rests on EV-GPS-02825, which the pre-pass tagged IMPAIRED with issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW at weight_multiplier 0.85, and the driver discloses that discount.

No repeat-deviation pattern may be built against this driver: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 against a threshold of 3, and 1 flag over 162 completed_trips_90d is a rate of 0.006 against a threshold of 0.05, so POL-RD-06's FULL_REFUND uplift and its conduct referral are both unavailable on this record. POL-GEN-01 confines the test to those two trailing-window fields and bars reading the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter in their place.

The remedy is arithmetic and capped under POL-RD-02: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 19.0) x the 1.0 surge recorded on EV-FARE-02825) + 0.80 platform fee = 20.42; refund = 26.73 - 20.42 = 6.31, rounded UP to 6.35. That is 23.6% of charged_total, far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is a partial refund capped at 6.35 — the 10.00 the rider contests exceeds anything POL-RD-02 can produce.

Nothing may be added on top of that figure: the fare_breakdown itemises 0.00 of ERP across zero gantry lines and carries no airport surcharge, and a trip that ends rather than originates at an airport attracts none, so POL-RD-09 yields no pass-through correction and no billing-integrity refund on this record.

The driver does not press an external-cause exoneration, and none is available: POL-RD-13 tests a traffic-cause assertion against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else, and no advisory covers this corridor — EV-ADVIS-02825-01 is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0; the chat log is empty (0 messages), so no rider instruction exists either. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run, no exculpatory clause is invoked against the absent advisory, and the case resolves on POL-RD-02's arithmetic alone.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties, on trip TRP-02825. The platform's optimal route was 14.0 km (EV-TRIP-02825); the GPS trace records 18.2 km driven (EV-GPS-02825), an excess of 4.2 km, or 30.0% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 gates are passed — the excess exceeds 0.8 km and exceeds 20% — so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not MATERIAL (comfortably under 50% and under 8.0 km), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged and no driver-conduct referral arises; the driver's two trailing-window counts (deviation_flags_90d 1, completed_trips_90d 162) do not meet the pattern test either, and the lifetime counter was correctly not used for it.

On the trace: EV-GPS-02825 is impaired at schema level — weight 0.85, issue GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW (a 40.0 s sampling gap of 0.4 km from 14:00:32 to 14:01:12). Measured against POL-RD-07 it is NOT impaired for policy purposes: the gap is under 90 s (limb a), the jump is under 500 m (limb b), and the sampling interval is 10 s, under 30 s (limb c). The excess therefore stands as measured, no POL-RD-10(3) escalation is engaged, and the trace is down-weighted in confidence only.
